baseline_models.focus_anchor: The parallel clauses "فإن يصبروا" and "وإن يستعتبوا" oppose bodily endurance to a spoken request for restored favor.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two conditionals vary the condemned person's response while fixing both residence and refusal: endurance does not move them from the fire, and appeal does not move them into the class whose reconciliation is granted.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint against panic supplies the bodily-endurance arm of the paired alternatives.
Kindled fire supplies the fixed destination that endurance cannot alter.
Settled residence supplies the durative location shared by either response.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists two possible reactions to punishment.
changed_reading.after: The ayah neutralizes two kinds of agency: the body may endure and speech may petition, but neither changes settled outcome.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The placement of "يصبروا" immediately before "فالنار مثوى لهم" permits a coercive rather than virtuous shade of endurance.
baseline_models.mechanism: The packet's forced-holding and no-outlet branches of صبر combine with settled residence: their endurance can be the condition of being held through an inescapable severity, not a saving moral achievement.

activation_trace.role: Coercive holding for death or oath supplies a custody-like shade to their endurance.
Severity with no outlet supplies the closed condition in which that holding continues.
Long settlement converts temporary restraint into an abiding condition.

changed_reading.before: Their patience is voluntary fortitude within pain.
changed_reading.after: Their "patience" may be enforced staying-power inside a severity from which there is no route out.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The form-pair "يستعتبوا / المعتبين" moves from seeking removal of blame to denial of being among those granted that restoration.
baseline_models.mechanism: The second conditional concerns status repair, not merely pain relief. Its passive-result wording denies entry into a reconciled class while the fire remains their settled location.

activation_trace.role: Settled residence supplies the status and location that the attempted reconciliation fails to reverse.
Endurance supplies the nonverbal alternative against which the failed relational appeal is set.

changed_reading.before: They ask for relief and are refused.
changed_reading.after: They seek restoration from blame or favor, but are denied the status transition itself.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: "النار مثوى لهم" names fire through a noun that can denote a home, lodging, or place prepared for a guest.
baseline_models.mechanism: The domestic and guest-bearing range of مثوى makes the predication an anti-hospitality formula: what receives and keeps them is the fire.

activation_trace.role: Home, lodging, and guest imagery supplies the reception frame assigned to the fire.
The actual kindled fire fills the host-place with punitive rather than protective content.

changed_reading.before: Fire is simply the destination in which they remain.
changed_reading.after: Fire is their inverted lodging: a receiving place whose hospitality consists in keeping rather than sheltering them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier pair "طوعا أو كرها" reaches one arrival, while the focus pair "يصبروا / يستعتبوا" reaches one fixed outcome. This strengthens the baseline reading of the focus conditionals as alternatives whose difference of posture does not produce a difference of destination.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint supplies one voluntary-seeming posture in the focus pair.
Settled residence supplies the unchanged endpoint of that posture.
Willing compliance supplies one pole of an earlier paired choice that still ends in arrival.
Compelling another to bear what is disliked supplies the opposed pole whose outcome is likewise fixed.

structural_cues: 41:11 coordinates "طوعا أو كرها" and resolves both with "أتينا طائعين".
41:24 repeats a two-arm construction with "فإن" and "وإن" while preserving one settled result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two paired alternatives and their convergent outcomes; I infer a null-choice rhyme across the surah. A live alternative is that 41:11 concerns cosmic obedience and is not intended as a direct template for 41:24.

changed_reading.before: Endurance and appeal are merely two reactions listed side by side.
changed_reading.after: They form a null-choice architecture: inner posture can vary, but the governing outcome does not.

context_deltas.mechanism: The approach to the focus ayah herds enemies toward the fire and holds their ranks; later there is no turn-aside, and the surah closes with encompassing mastery. Together these cues turn the carceral صبر branch into a coherent custody sequence ending in settled fire.

activation_trace.role: Coercive holding supplies the focus ayah's custody-like endurance.
Severity without an outlet supplies the inescapable condition of that custody.
Settled residence makes the custody durative rather than momentary.
Driving and collecting a group toward one destination supplies the inbound movement to custody.
Organized holding and restraint supplies control of the gathered ranks.
Turning aside from a direction, under explicit negation, supplies the absence of an escape route.
Encompassment by domination or destruction supplies the final perimeter around the no-outlet residence.

structural_cues: 41:19 immediately begins the judgment sequence by gathering enemies to the fire and restraining them.
41:48 states "ما لهم من محيص"; 41:54 closes with total encompassment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies herding, organized restraint, no turning aside, and destructive encompassment; I connect them as a custody path. They could instead be separate judgment images without a single carceral mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The fire is a painful place in which they happen to remain.
changed_reading.after: The fire is the terminus of a controlled procession: gathered, held, denied a side-exit, and enclosed into residence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Bodily organs witness and are made to speak after concealment fails. Against that evidentiary sequence, "يستعتبوا" becomes a post-disclosure plea for restored standing, and "فما هم من المعتبين" reads as closure after the record has spoken rather than refusal amid uncertainty.

activation_trace.role: Settled residence supplies the consequence that the post-evidence plea cannot reopen.
Testimony that declares from knowledge supplies an evidentiary record before the focus appeal.
Actual speech supplies the compelled articulation of that record by the body.
Covering and concealment, explicitly shown to fail, supplies the collapse of the defense's hiddenness.

structural_cues: 41:20-22 moves from arrival, to bodily testimony, to interrogation of the speaking skins, to failed concealment.
The focus appeal follows immediately after 41:23 names the fatal prior assumption.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies witnesses, compelled speech, and failed concealment; I infer a forensic arrow from completed evidence to a closed restoration plea. An alternative is moral self-exposure without a procedural courtroom frame.

changed_reading.before: A request for favor is rejected without an articulated process.
changed_reading.after: The request comes after embodied evidence has closed the factual question, so it cannot restore the petitioners' standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: What becomes due is described as fixed, recompense is tied to deeds, and withholding from right is negated. These cues sharpen the denied استعتاب as an attempt to renegotiate settled liability rather than a still-open invitation to repair.

activation_trace.role: Settled residence supplies the operative consequence of the fixed liability.
A binding due or established entitlement supplies the fixity of the pronouncement against them.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the deed-to-outcome relation surrounding the fire residence.
Withholding or confining someone from a right, explicitly negated, constrains the fixed outcome as non-capricious.

structural_cues: 41:25 says "وحق عليهم القول" before the focus outcome is restated.
41:28 repeats "جزاء" around the fire and abiding house; 41:46 explicitly negates wrongdoing toward servants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a binding outcome, act-matched recompense, and negated withholding of right; I infer legal finality around the appeal. A live alternative is a moral-causal account with no procedural implication.

changed_reading.before: The appeal fails because mercy is simply unavailable at that moment.
changed_reading.after: The appeal attempts to reopen a deed-linked liability already made binding, so restored standing is no longer an open disposition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's guest-capable مثوى is expanded into "دار الخلد" for the fire's people, while the opposed group receives a prepared نزل from mercy. The whole-surah polarity makes the focus phrase a deliberate anti-reception rather than incidental dwelling vocabulary.

activation_trace.role: Home, lodging, and guest imagery supplies the focus ayah's reception frame.
Kindled fire reverses the protective expectation of that lodging frame.
Persistence that does not quickly perish supplies the duration of the opposed fire-house.
A reception provision prepared for one who arrives supplies the positive hospitality pole.
Tender mercy supplies the character of the host behind the positive reception.

structural_cues: 41:28 expands the focus result as "لهم فيها دار الخلد".
41:30-32 forms a welcome sequence ending with "نزلا من غفور رحيم".
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two residence/reception lexicons with opposed occupants and outcomes; I infer a designed hospitality polarity. The alternative is that the shared lodging vocabulary is conventional and not a deliberate contrast.

changed_reading.before: Fire is one destination, while the garden is another.
changed_reading.after: The surah stages rival receptions: merciful provision for welcomed arrivals versus fire as the permanent anti-guesthouse of those denied restoration.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later in the surah, صبر enables the active reversal of evil and enmity into intimate alliance. Returning that use to 41:24 distinguishes timely ethical patience, which can transform relations, from post-judgment endurance, which cannot obtain عتب or relocate its bearer.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint supplies the focus endurance whose saving efficacy is now in question.
Pushing away the harmful thing supplies patience with an active ethical channel before judgment.
Actual enmity supplies the relationship available for transformation.
Love, support, and alliance supplies the transformed relational state.
Closeness and kin-like intimacy intensifies the repaired state that timely conduct can produce.
The repeated self-restraint branch identifies patience as the capacity that receives this relational reversal.

structural_cues: 41:34 gives a causal sequence from repelling with what is better to enemy becoming intimate ally.
41:35 twice restricts receipt of that sequence, first to those who practiced صبر.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root and a reversible social mechanism; I supply the temporal arrow that patience is effective before closure but inert as a post-judgment tactic. The two occurrences could simply describe unrelated kinds of patience.

changed_reading.before: Patience is a stable virtue whose presence should carry the same value in either setting.
changed_reading.after: Patience is phase-sensitive: enacted as ethical restraint it can repair enmity, but reduced to endurance after judgment it cannot secure reconciliation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late human portrait alternates tireless requests for good, severed hope under harm, turning away in ease, and expansive prayer in distress. That cycle makes "يستعتبوا" legible as pressure-generated bargaining as well as possible remorse, explaining why the speech act alone does not establish restored favor.

activation_trace.role: Settled residence supplies what the crisis-generated appeal seeks but fails to change.
Calling and drawing by speech supplies persistent verbal request for desired good.
Cutting off hope supplies one affective pressure behind speech under harm.
A second image of severed hope intensifies the crisis posture rather than proving relational repair.
Side and breadth imagery joins turning one's side in ease to an expansive prayer under harm.
The spoken call supplies the distress response at the other end of that oscillation.

structural_cues: 41:49 moves directly from unwearied prayer for good to despair when harm touches.
41:51 pairs turning away under favor with "دعاء عريض" when evil touches.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated ease-distress response cycle; I infer that the focus appeal may belong to instrumental crisis speech. A materially live alternative is sincere but too-late remorse, which the cycle cannot exclude.

changed_reading.before: Seeking عتب transparently demonstrates a repaired inward relation.
changed_reading.after: The request may be distress-driven bargaining within a known response cycle; uttering it does not itself make the speakers recipients of restoration.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the surface noun is ordinary fire, not an explicit lamp or disclosure term. It remains anchored in the packet's light and visible-marker branches of ن و ر and in the surrounding collapse of concealment before witnesses. Render it only as a secondary exposure layer of the punitive fire, not as a replacement for actual burning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus word "النار" resolves to ن و ر branches of illumination and visible prominence as well as kindled fire.

activation_trace.role: Light and illumination supplies fire with an exposing function in addition to heat.
Visible prominence supplies the image of a condition in which what was hidden stands out.
Presence with direct witnessing supplies the surrounding scene of exposure.
Covering and concealment supplies the failed strategy that exposure reverses.
Hiddenness, explicitly denied, supplies a later confirmation that nothing remains concealed.

changed_reading.before: Fire acts only by inflicting heat and pain.
changed_reading.after: Fire also images forced visibility: the settled condition where concealed acts and assumptions can no longer remain covered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because نار normally denotes literal fire, while the packet also preserves نائرة as feud among people. It remains anchored by that exact focus-root branch and by the surah's imposed companions and explicit enemy-to-ally reversal. Downstream prose should qualify it as a relational overlay on literal punishment, not identify fire exhaustively with social conflict.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus "النار" carries the packet branch "النائرة بين القوم", while the same clause denies a successful request for relational appeasement.

activation_trace.role: Feud and enmity among a group supplies a relational interior to the literal fire.
A companion bound to another supplies the imposed social environment that persists around the condemned.
Making something appear good supplies the companions' corrupting mediation of that environment.
Actual enmity supplies the relation that is reversible in the ethical counter-scene.
Love and alliance supplies the repaired state available there but denied by the focus appeal.

changed_reading.before: The fire is an external punishment suffered by separate individuals.
changed_reading.after: As a contained secondary image, it is also the abiding social heat of corrupted companionship and enmity that can no longer be appeased into alliance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The stopper and vessel image is far from the ordinary verbal sense of صبر, and the ك ف ي citation uses a legitimate but non-dominant mapped root. The model remains anchored by exact packet branches plus the focus's settled residence and the closing encompassment. Render it explicitly as a material analogy for closure, never as a lexical translation of "يصبروا".
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet gives focus صبر a stopper branch and joins it syntactically to the fire as settled residence.

activation_trace.role: A stopper sealing a bottle or well supplies the material image of an exit being closed.
Settled residence supplies what is enclosed rather than merely passing through.
Closing and drawing together from the split ك ف ف target supplies a second, exploratory closure image.
Encompassment by domination or destruction supplies the outer seal around the residence.

changed_reading.before: The abode is permanent because time continues without end.
changed_reading.after: As a qualified material analogy, permanence is also engineered closure: a settled interior stopped and encompassed against exit.

strongest_changes: The focus alternatives became a null-choice between enduring and petitioning, neither of which changes settled outcome.
The judgment sequence turned endurance into custody: gathering, organized restraint, no side-exit, and final encompassment.
Bodily testimony and failed concealment reframed استعتاب as a post-evidence request for restored standing.
The later effective use of صبر made patience phase-sensitive: relationally transformative before closure, inert as a tactic after it.
The opposed نزل and دار الخلد language sharpened مثوى into an inverted hospitality system.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context joined spatial custody, forensic speech, hospitality, and social repair around one compact ayah. Most distinctive was the same صبر root moving from the capacity that transforms an enemy into an intimate ally to endurance that cannot win reconciliation once fire has become residence.
remaining_uncertainties: The ع ت ب focus root has no branch inventory in the packet, so the reconciliation model is morphology-driven and cannot be branch-audited directly.
The carceral and sealed-residence readings depend on form-distant صبر branches and should remain explicitly exploratory where used.
The structural rhyme between 41:11 and 41:24 may be a reader-supplied analogy rather than an intended cross-surah mechanism.
The exposure and feud readings are anchored but secondary overlays on literal fire, not substitutes for it.
